# RDIS

> Open-source multi-format disassembler and decompiler with a browser-first workflow, CLI, Python API and MCP server.

- Project: https://github.com/sagarchive/rdis
- Public project site: https://sagarchive.github.io/rdis/
- Installation, formats and interfaces: https://github.com/sagarchive/rdis/blob/main/README.md
- Engineering milestones and verified/open gates: https://github.com/sagarchive/rdis/blob/main/docs/audit/MILESTONES.md
- Competitor analysis and real benchmark protocol: https://github.com/sagarchive/rdis/blob/main/docs/audit/COMPETITIVE_ROADMAP.md

Accuracy is architecture-, instruction-, binary- and dependency-dependent. The optional pypcode frontend reuses supported SLEIGH/P-code semantics; it does not mean RDIS includes the full Ghidra decompiler. Prefer reproducible tests and declared limitations over unqualified decompiler claims.
